<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<CustomField xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>Status__c</fullName>
    <description>Pending, Received, Sent, Success, Failed (with Next Retry At: waiting for auto-retry). Set Retry to send again. Abandoned is kept for older records.</description>
    <inlineHelpText>Pending, Received, Sent, Success, Failed (with Next Retry At: waiting for auto-retry). Set Retry to send again. Abandoned is kept for older records.</inlineHelpText>
    <label>Status</label>
    <required>false</required>
    <trackTrending>false</trackTrending>
    <type>Picklist</type>
    <valueSet>
        <restricted>true</restricted>
        <valueSetDefinition>
            <sorted>false</sorted>
            <value>
                <fullName>Pending</fullName>
                <default>true</default>
                <label>Pending</label>
            </value>
            <value>
                <fullName>Received</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>Received</label>
            </value>
            <value>
                <fullName>Sent</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>Sent</label>
            </value>
            <value>
                <fullName>Success</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>Success</label>
            </value>
            <value>
                <fullName>Failed</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>Failed</label>
            </value>
            <value>
                <fullName>Retry</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>Retry</label>
            </value>
            <value>
                <fullName>Abandoned</fullName>
                <default>false</default>
                <label>Abandoned</label>
            </value>
        </valueSetDefinition>
    </valueSet>
</CustomField>
